```{=html}
<div class="lede">
  <div class="pull-quote">
    &ldquo;Regimes do not announce themselves. The topology, sometimes, does.&rdquo;
  </div>
  <p>The Euler characteristic is the modest invariant: an alternating sum of simplex counts that, written down, fits on a postcard. Tracked across a filtration it encodes considerably more than the postcard suggests, and it costs a single pass&mdash;linear in the size of the complex, where persistence pays for a matrix reduction. The price is that it is not complete; different topologies can share it. The work here makes that trade honestly: <em>Euler characteristic surfaces</em> and <em>profiles</em> as fast, interpretable descriptors, with the Euler calculus and stability theory that say what they can be trusted to see.</p>
  <p>Time series and dynamical systems are where they earn their keep. A regime transition, a crash, a monsoon onset is often a change in the shape of the data before it is a change in its mean, and the working assumption throughout is the topologist's: <em>the data is high-dimensional, but the regime is not</em>. The Euler characteristic carries the foundations and the regime-detection work below; the work on markets uses persistence and complex networks, the older tools of the same trade.</p>
</div>
```

## Foundations

```{=html}
<div class="section-byline">
  <span>Filed under <em>Theory</em></span>
  <span>Euler calculus &middot; stability &middot; inference</span>
</div>
<p class="section-kicker">What the invariant measures, and when to believe it.</p>
```

The intersection Euler characteristic profile measures how two point clouds overlap: the Euler characteristic of the intersection of their ball unions, as a function of scale, from a single alpha-complex sweep. It is the instrument behind the [neural-network work](networks.html), and it needs its own theory.

1. [**Statistical Inference for Topological Interaction.** With Kazuhiro Kawamura, Atish Mitra, and Pramita Bagchi. In preparation.]{.in-prep}
1. **The Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile: Euler Calculus and Stability for Topological Interaction of Ball Unions.** With Kazuhiro Kawamura and Atish Mitra. Under review at the *Journal of Applied and Computational Topology*. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06180).

## Markets

```{=html}
<div class="section-byline">
  <span>Filed under <em>Application</em></span>
  <span>Crashes &middot; extreme events &middot; recovery</span>
</div>
<p class="section-kicker">The moods of the stock market, read topologically.</p>
```

```{=html}
<figure class="fig-right">
  <img src="../images/plate-dynamics.svg" alt="A wavy time series above a persistence barcode showing how topological features appear and disappear across filtration scale." style="width:100%" />
</figure>
```

A long collaboration with Md. Nurujjaman's group at NIT Sikkim carries persistence and network methods into statistical finance: which crashes are extreme, how a crash propagates across sectors and commodities, and why, after COVID-19, not every sector recovered along the same curve.

1. **Causality Analysis of COVID-19 Induced Crashes in Stock and Commodity Markets: A Topological Perspective.** With Buddha Nath Sharma, Anish Rai, Salam Rabindrajit Luwang, and Md. Nurujjaman. *International Journal of Modern Physics C*, 2025. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1142/S0129183126500221) &middot; [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14431).
1. **Complex Network Analysis of Cryptocurrency Market During Crashes.** With Kundan Mukhia, Anish Rai, Salam Rabindrajit Luwang, Md. Nurujjaman, and Chittaranjan Hens. *Physica A*, 2024. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.physa.2024.130095) &middot; [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.05642).
1. **Identifying Extreme Events in the Stock Market: A Topological Data Analysis.** With Anish Rai, Buddha Nath Sharma, Salam Rabindrajit Luwang, and Md. Nurujjaman. *Chaos*, 2024. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0220424) &middot; [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.16052).
1. **A Sentiment-Based Modeling and Analysis of Stock Price During the COVID-19: U- and Swoosh-Shaped Recovery.** With Anish Rai, Ajit Mahata, Md. Nurujjaman, and Kanish Debnath. *Physica A*, 2022. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.physa.2021.126810) &middot; [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.03986).
